page.title: Book a room
page.description: Fill out the form below and we will process your request as soon as possible. A booking is a request and will be confirmed by email.

services.silentDiscoDescription: Three channels, DJs and lighting for a whole party. Available in Teglverket, Tivoli and Storelogen.
services.cateringDescription: Kvarteret's kitchen tailors food to your needs – from tapas to large events.

schedule.getInOutHint: Remember to allow time for setup and teardown within the booking's start and end times.
schedule.roomBusyTitle: {rooms} is busy during the selected time
schedule.roomBusyDescription: Change the time or remove the room from the booking.
schedule.flexibleDates: The date and room are flexible. Kvarteret may suggest another time or room if that works better.
schedule.noRooms: No rooms are available for booking right now.
schedule.selectDateTime: Choose a date and time to see available rooms.

dateTime.houseClosed: The house is closed on this day. Choose another date.
dateTime.selectDate: Choose a date to see available times.
dateTime.noAvailableTimes: No times are available for the selected room during this period.
dateTime.whatGetInOut: What do get-in and get-out mean?
dateTime.getInExplanation: For organizers, get-in means that the renter enters the room at the agreed time and takes responsibility for it.
dateTime.getOutExplanation: Get-out means that the renter must be completely out of the room by the agreed end time, including cleanup and teardown.
dateTime.multiDayExplanation: For bookings spanning several days, get-in on the first day and get-out on the last day set the booking times.
dateTime.doorsHint: The time the audience is let in – not the organizer's get-in.
dateTime.notEnoughTimes: There are not enough times to show a time picker.

event.name: Event name *
event.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly tell us about your event...

needs.furniturePlaceholder: E.g. tables and chairs for 30 people, U-shaped setup, standing tables along the walls.
needs.technicianNotice: A dedicated technician costs NOK 3,500 excl. VAT per technician. Cancellation must be made no later than 10 days before the event.
needs.riggingSetupNotice: Costs NOK 2,000 excl. VAT. Remember to include setup time within the booking's start and end times.
needs.riggingTeardownNotice: Costs NOK 2,000 excl. VAT. Remember to include teardown time within the booking's start and end times.
needs.amphi: Need for amphitheater seating — Tivoli only

catering.catering: I would like a catering quote
catering.cateringDescription: Our head chef will contact you so you can discuss catering options for your event.
catering.cateringPlaceholder: Describe your wishes for food, snacks or drinks.
catering.cateringInfoBody1: Det Akademiske Kvarter offers a wide selection of good food and drinks. If you need food, snacks or drinks for your event, you can request it here.
catering.cateringInfoBody2: Our head chef will contact you after your request has been submitted so that you can find a solution that suits your event. We adapt the menu to your wishes and needs, from simple service to larger meals.
catering.cateringInfoBody3: Please let us know about allergies and special requirements so we can include them in the planning.
catering.cateringInfoBody4: Bringing your own food and drinks is not permitted on our premises.
catering.barRequired: Your event requires a bar in the room.
catering.barNotRequired: Your event does not require a bar in the room.
catering.bar: I would like a bar in the room
catering.barSelf: I will staff the bar myself
catering.barSelfDescription: Staffing your own bar at your own event is free. This requires health, safety and bar training from us. It takes about one hour and a link will be sent when the booking is confirmed.
catering.barHouseDescription: Price: NOK 2,000 excl. VAT. Subject to capacity.

promotion.question: Would you like Studentersamfunnet to promote your event through its channels?
promotion.followUp: We will email you a link after the booking has been submitted.

terms.intro: Booking a venue at Det Akademiske Kvarter creates a request that must be approved by a room coordinator. A booking is not confirmed until you have received confirmation by email.
terms.cancellationIntro: Cancellations must follow our cancellation terms. Late cancellations will incur a fee.
terms.accept: I have read, understood and accept the rental terms and cancellation terms.
terms.notRead: You have not read and understood our terms!
terms.contentUnavailable: The content could not be loaded.

form.successDescription: Thank you for your booking request. We will process it as soon as possible and contact you by email.
form.outsideHoursDescription: The selected start or end time is outside the house's opening hours for this day.
form.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

validation.doors: Choose when the doors open to the public.
validation.terms: Confirm that you have read and accept the booking terms.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.ticket: Add at least one ticket type with a price for paid events.
validation.ticketType: Choose whether the event is free or paid.
validation.organizationNumber: The organization number may only contain digits.
validation.promotion: Choose whether you want to promote the event.
validation.availabilityConflict: Choose a time that does not overlap an existing booking.
validation.outsideOpeningHours: Choose a time within opening hours.
